interpretation: The exact Jacobi/lookahead scheduler preserves greedy IDs but does not amortize target passes: it accepts about two tokens per two target passes and is slower than the SI-001 path. It remains opt-in and is rejected for promotion. A better candidate drafter or multi-branch lookahead is required.
memory_note: Peak Metal increased from the 1540 MiB SI-001 target to 1544 MiB and RSS reached 2373 MiB in this exploratory run.
